      "target": "在目标身上放置一个持续 6 回合的奥术漩涡。每回合，奥术漩涡会随机寻找视野内的另一个敌人，并且释放一次奥术射线，对一条线上的所有敌人造成 %0.2f 奥术伤害。\n\t\t若没有发现其他敌人，则目标会额外承受 50%% 奥术伤害。\n\t\t若目标死亡，则奥术漩涡爆炸并释放所有的剩余奥术伤害，在 2 格半径范围内形成奥术爆炸。\n\t\t伤害受法术强度加成。"

      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/spells/fire.lua",
      "source": "Conjures up a cone of flame with radius %d. Any targets caught in the area will suffer Burning Shock, stunning them and dealing %0.2f fire damage over %d turns.\n\t\tThe damage will increase with your Spellpower.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "在你前方制造一片 %d 格半径锥形范围的火焰。任何在此范围的目标会被燃烧的火焰冲击震慑，共受到 %0.2f 点火焰伤害，持续 %d 回合。\n\t\t伤害受法术强度加成。"

      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/spells/glacial-waste.lua",
      "source": "Your hiemal shield is stronger, taking %d%% less damage from all attacks.\n\t\tWhen under 1 life this effect is increased to %d%%.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "你进一步强化寒冬护盾，护盾受到的所有伤害降低 %d%%。\n\t\t当生命值在 1 以下时，这一效果提升至 %d%%。"

      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/spells/nightfall.lua",
      "source": "Dark fumes erupt from the ground in radius %d for 5 turns. Any creature entering the circle will receive either a bane of confusion or a bane of blindness.\n\t\tOnly one bane can affect a creature.\n\t\tBanes last for %d turns, and also deal %0.2f darkness damage.\n\t\tThe damage will increase with your Spellpower.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "黑暗之雾笼罩 %d 格范围的地面 5 回合。任何生物走进去都会受到混乱灾祸或致盲灾祸的影响。\n\t\t同一个生物同时只会被一种灾祸效果影响。\n\t\t灾祸效果持续 %d 回合，每回合造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害。\n\t\t伤害受法术强度加成。"

      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/techniques/buckler-training.lua",
      "source": "Any time you block an attack with Buckler Expertise or Buckler Mastery you instantly counterattack with your sling for %d%% damage  This can only occur up to %d time(s) per turn.\n\t\t\t",

      "special": null,
      "target": "每当你的盾牌训练或格挡大师技能挡住攻击时，你立刻使用投石索发动一次伤害 %d%% 的反击。每回合最多只能发动 %d 次反击。\n\t\t\t"
